measured_limiter.attribution: The controller and variable identifier span boundary are solved on the held-out lexical screen. The linear single-state copy value does not losslessly recover the identity carried by a correctly selected source semantic state.

materially_distinct_architecture.name: causal_semantic_transition_identity_codec
materially_distinct_architecture.input: the selected causal semantic ABI state minus its immediately preceding semantic ABI state
materially_distinct_architecture.reason: The adjacent-state transition isolates information added when the selected source unit entered the frozen causal host, reducing prompt-context interference that a single-state linear value cannot remove.
materially_distinct_architecture.composition: the transition codec adds a learned correction to the frozen parent copy semantic value before the existing bounded same-shape residual

training.loss: authoritative frozen-host full-vocabulary cross-entropy on pointer realization units only
training.selection: minimum observed training pointer realization cross-entropy

decision_rule.replication_requirement: If both screens pass, run two independently initialized full staged semantic-transition-codec lineages so final promotion evidence contains three paired seeds rather than three codec heads on one frozen planner.
decision_rule.on_failure: Preserve the artifact and evidence, close the transition codec branch, and do not claim Phase 4.
decision_rule.on_pass: Execute two full-lineage replications, then preregister held-out test, signed package transfer across CPU-only and CUDA-capable receivers, semantic retention, and matched CPU inference certification.
